description: This PHP class 'EmployeeSupervisorModel' represents a model used in the OrangeHRM system to serialize employee supervisor and reporting method data for API responses. It utilizes traits and methods to define data filtering and attribute naming conventions, specifically for reporting to and supervisor information.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes supervisor and reporting method information for an employee, conforming to the 'Normalizable' interface to be used in API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a ReportTo entity, setting filters and attribute names for serialization.
